newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-Ethiopian football team members opt for Italy.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-Ethiopian football team members opt for Italy.

text.p: A number of the 23-strong Ethiopian national soccer team decided to stay in Italy on Tuesday rather than fly to Casablanca for an African National Cup match against Morocco, the Ethiopian embassy said.

The group stayed overnight at a hotel close to the Italian capital and hotel manager Alvaro Benedetti told Reuters 16 people, including the coach, had left with their luggage and passports and their whereabouts were not known.
Seven members of the original group were still there, he said. "The embassy called on Tuesday morning saying seven people would stay on," Benedetti said.

Ethiopian state radio reported that most of the team had disappeared while on a stopover in Rome. It said the team leader had asked to return home with the remaining players saying they could not now take on Morocco.

An Ethiopian embassy spokesman said: "It is a personal decision. Some people do not want to go. At the moment we do not know why they do not want to go to Morocco and we cannot say how many players are involved."
The players arrived on Monday afternoon from Addis Ababa and were scheduled to fly to Casablanca on Tuesday. "They missed the flight," an official at Rome's main airport said.
